segments.title: 第193章 當托兒
segments.content:
Reigniting the Verdant Years Chapter 193: Acting as a Shill

The New Year's Day holiday at Fuzhong No. 1 High, to be precise, was three and a half days long.

Of course, if you included the day of the New Year's Gala, it would be four days.

School let out on the morning of the 1st, and with Friday the 2nd off, it connected right to the weekend.

Then, on Sunday the 4th, students had to return for evening self-study.

For students who needed to attend cram sessions or competition classes, like Ying Chanxi, they had to return to school in the afternoon.

As evening fell, Xu Youyu, who had been writing for the entire afternoon, was just about to look for Li Luo to go to school together when she saw a pile of things on the kitchen floor.

A large bag of rice, many cartons of eggs, and a big bag of carrots and ham sausages.

Besides that, there were two large barrels of cooking oil, as well as a whole box of plastic food containers and insulated foam boxes.

Li Luo and Zhao Rongjun were gathered in the kitchen taking inventory. After confirming there were no issues, Li Luo stood up, patted her butt, and twisted her neck, "For the first day, we won't make too much. Let's just practice and scout things out."

"Are we making it now?" Zhao Rongjun asked. "Don't we still have evening self-study?"

"Of course not now, but we can do some of the prep work in advance." Li Luo pointed at the carrots and ham sausages. "The eggs can be beaten on the spot, but we can dice the carrots and slice the ham sausages first."

"I already cooked the rice this afternoon. After it cools down, we can use it tonight when we get back."

"According to the plan, we'll find some acquaintances to test the flavor and make a sales pitch today, so we won't make too much. Let's start with ten servings of fried rice."

Given the size of their wok at home, they could fry three to four servings of fried rice at once.

Just counting the cooking time, one wok of egg fried rice would take about three to five minutes. Ten servings would only take about ten minutes.

Plus, with Zhao Rongjun assisting on the side, the full 40 minutes of the third evening self-study session would definitely be more than enough time.

"So… what are you two up to?" Xu Youyu, who didn't know about their plan yet, listened with a completely bewildered expression, not quite understanding the situation.

"Making money, of course, Senior." Li Luo smiled at her. "Our esteemed President, don't go reporting us, okay?"

Third evening self-study session at Fuzhong No. 1 High.

Yan Zhusheng sat at her desk, diligently reviewing her lessons. Occasionally, she would get distracted and take out the harmonica Li Luo had given her to play with.

By now, Li Luo had already gone home from school. For her, it felt like a game that had entered garbage time; she just wanted class to end quickly.

Thinking about the task Li Luo had given her tonight, Yan Zhusheng carefully reviewed and memorized it again. When the bell signaling the end of evening self-study rang, she found Xu Yinghuan.

"Huanhuan, I'll treat you to something good tonight."

"Huh?" Xu Yinghuan paused for a moment. "Something good? Zhusheng, are you taking me to the supermarket?"

Yan Zhusheng shook her head. "You'll know when you come with me."

The boarding students at Fuzhong No. 1 High made up about two-thirds of the total student body. The tide of people after school was quite a spectacular sight, much like a herd of piglets scampering joyfully down a mountain after a gate was opened.

Yan Zhusheng led Xu Yinghuan out of the school gate, into the dormitory area, past the bustling supermarket with its long queue, and through the area behind the boys' dorm building, arriving at the fire escape gate next to the girls' dorm building.

Xu Yinghuan followed with a puzzled look, unable to help but ask curiously, "Zhusheng, why are we here… uh?"

Before she could finish, she followed their direction of travel and spotted an electric tricycle outside the iron gate, along with several familiar figures standing beside it.

"Class President, Xixi?" Xu Yinghuan was stunned. She then walked to the iron gate with a look of surprise and confusion. "Why is Zhao Rongjun here too? And… and Senior?"

At that moment, Li Luo and Zhao Rongjun had already opened the foam box on the electric tricycle, taken out two servings of egg fried rice, and passed them through the gap in the iron gate into Yan Zhusheng and Xu Yinghuan's hands.

Ying Chanxi, standing nearby, smiled helplessly. "The two of them suddenly said they wanted to do this, so I just came along to see."

"I think it's pretty interesting." Xu Youyu giggled at the side. "But these are all acquaintances. You two aren't still going to charge them, are you?"

"Here." Yan Zhusheng took a twenty-yuan bill from her pocket and handed it toward Li Luo.

"Here for what? I already said it's my treat." Li Luo shot her a look, patted her hand to signal her to put it away, and then said, "However, there's no such thing as a free lunch, and of course, no free late-night snack."

"Take these."

Saying that, Li Luo took out a dozen pairs of disposable chopsticks and handed them to Yan Zhusheng and Xu Yinghuan.

"What are these for?" Xu Yinghuan blinked, her brain not yet processing it. "What am I going to do with so many chopsticks by myself?"

"Who said they were all for you?" Li Luo smiled. "You can have the egg fried rice for free, but I have one condition."

"Later, when you get back to your dorm room, open your egg fried rice and just stroll around in front of your roommates, let them get a whiff of the aroma."

"If anyone asks where you got the egg fried rice, just say you bought it at the iron gate. Ten yuan a serving, a very generous portion, so much that you can't finish it yourself, and ask if they want some."

"But, don't give them too much. Just a couple of bites for each person to taste. Finish the rest yourselves. Don't let them get full."

"After you finish eating, add one more thing. Say that they sell a very limited quantity of this fried rice, and you were just lucky to grab a serving today. A lot of people queued up but didn't get any."

Xu Yinghuan listened, dumbfounded, then quickly understood. Her eyes widened as she said, "You're using me for advertising?! Where is this queue of people who couldn't buy any?"

"Not today, but there will be in the future." Li Luo said with a cheerful laugh. "Will you do it? If you do, then as long as you want to eat it and we're still making it, we'll provide you with free egg fried rice."

"Really?"

"Why would I lie to you?"

"Okay, okay, okay," Xu Yinghuan said with a happy smile. "Then leave it to me! I can even run to a few more dorm rooms! I'm super familiar with the first-year girls' dorms!"

"No, no." Li Luo waved her hands repeatedly. "That would be too deliberate. You only need to promote it in your own dorm. We can't sell that much anyway, so it wouldn't be good if too many people came."

After sending off Yan Zhusheng and Xu Yinghuan, Li Luo's side received a few more acquaintances one after another.

They included Zhu Yufei and Zhang Guohuang from Class 8, Zhao Rongjun's deskmate Luo Jiajia, and Niu Qingling and Shao Youpeng from the rock and roll club.

In addition, there were a few other students Zhao Rongjun was relatively familiar with at Fuzhong No. 1 High.

Soon, all ten servings of fried rice in their hands had been given away, completing their mission for the day.

"Will this method of yours work?" Ying Chanxi asked with a skeptical look. "This will make a lot of people come and queue up tomorrow?"

"Don't underestimate the desire of boarding students in the dorms to find food." Li Luo smiled, not worried at all. "Besides, we won't sell a lot. From now on, we'll just sell twenty servings a day. Once they're sold out, we'll leave."

"I'm a little hungry." Xu Youyu rubbed her stomach. "Let's make a few more servings when we get back. I want to eat too."

"Alright." Li Luo nodded, then shouted toward a figure squatting by the roadside smoking, "Uncle! Let's go! We're done."

"All done?" Li Luo's uncle, Lin Xiufeng, threw his cigarette on the ground, stubbed it out with his heel, exhaled the last puff of smoke, and ambled over to the electric tricycle. "Let's go then."

The four youngsters obediently got on, sitting in the rear compartment of the electric tricycle.

Lin Xiufeng, on the other hand, plopped himself into the driver's seat. After a smooth start, he drove the four of them around the dormitory area and headed toward Bihai Lanting.

"So you guys are planning to come out and sell boxed meals every night from now on?" Lin Xiufeng asked, a little helplessly.

Previously, Li Luo had called him, saying she needed his help with something and had him get an electric tricycle.

He never expected it was to be a delivery driver for the two of them, and for egg fried rice at that.

"We'll sell for half a month at most." Li Luo said with a grin. "Uncle, if you're busy, you can just leave the tricycle here. I'll return it to you when I'm done with it."

"Better not. I'll come over every night," Lin Xiufeng said, shaking his head.

With these kids doing something like this, as an elder, Lin Xiufeng certainly couldn't just let them be. He felt more at ease watching over them.

However, he didn't try to control Li Luo or stop her from doing this.

After all, earning money through hard work with your own two hands was nothing to be ashamed of. Lin Xiufeng thought it was a good thing.

It's good for kids to experience some hardship.

Anyway, he had nothing to do late at night, so accompanying his niece to sell some boxed meals was fine.

What disappointed him a little was that he had originally thought this would be another good opportunity, like selling belts.

It turned out he was here to be a manual laborer.

"Uncle, let's split the money based on the effort put in," Li Luo said. "When the time comes, we'll divide the profits into five shares. Zhao Rongjun and I will each take two, and you'll take one."

"Why be so formal with me?" Lin Xiufeng said with a laugh. "You kids can just keep it."

"It's fine, even blood brothers settle accounts clearly," Li Luo said with a giggle. "We're just messing around. You can just treat it as playing house with us."

"Whatever you say. It wouldn't be bad to earn enough for a pack of cigarettes," Lin Xiufeng replied with a cheerful laugh.

"Cigarette money is definitely not a problem." Li Luo calculated for him, "I've worked it out. The cost of ingredients for one serving of our egg fried rice is actually just two yuan."

"We sell one box for ten yuan, so that's eight yuan in profit."

"Selling twenty boxes a day means a profit of one hundred and sixty."

"Uncle, you'll get 32 yuan. Buying a pack of cigarettes will be a piece of cake."

Hearing this, Lin Xiufeng suddenly froze.

"You can earn one hundred and sixty in one night?"

"That's right." Li Luo nodded. "And that's because we have limited time, so we can only manage to make about twenty boxes."

"But if word really gets out, the number of people coming to buy egg fried rice every night will definitely be far more than twenty."

"If we could sell fifty or sixty boxes a night, that would be four or five hundred in income."

As soon as these words were spoken, Lin Xiufeng fell silent. After dropping Li Luo and the others off at home, he waved his hand and left, lost in thought.

(End of Chapter)
